{{Quote|As you can well imagine, interstellar dining can be dangerous&mdash;for example, I found out the hard way that I'm allergic to both Dac anchovies and the Mon Calamari chef who'd prepared them.|Dexter Jettster mentions his Dac anchovy allergy in the menu at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
The '''Dac anchovy''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of edible [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] where they were cooked and eaten by the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] species. During [[Gender/Legends|his]] travels of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] visited Dac and tried Dac anchovies, although he discovered he was [[Allergy/Legends|allergic]] to them. Dexter later mentioned his intolerance of the fish, and the Mon Calamari who cooked them, in the introduction of his menu at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] he owned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dac anchovies were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].
